name: Palomar Holdings, Inc.
reason: Disciplined specialty E&S/earthquake underwriter compounding adjusted EPS at 86% 5y CAGR (5/6 years >=7%) with 10y avg ROE 14.6% and minimal acquisitions (acq/FCF 0.05); cat-exposure and softening property pricing (EPS at 1.0x 10y peak) are the key risks to test in deep dive.

name: Pinterest, Inc.
reason: Ad-funded discovery platform with only ~2 years of meaningful GAAP profit (EBIT margin 7.6% vs 10y avg -16.3%, adj/GAAP gap 96%) and a credible AI-search/agentic-shopping disintermediation threat make 5-10y earnings unforecastable.

name: Parsons Corp.
reason: Government services/engineering contractor whose growth is acquisition-led (acq/FCF 0.99 over 10y) with thin 6.6% EBIT margin, 10y avg ROIC 6.4% and consensus FY1 EPS -22.9% on federal budget exposure; no evident specialness.

name: Viatris, Inc.
reason: Generic/off-patent pharma with adjusted EPS shrinking 5.9%/yr over 10y, shares up 8.9%/yr from deal-making, net debt/EBITDA 3.4x and persistent generic price erosion.

name: Talen Energy Corp.
reason: Merchant wholesale power generator whose earnings are set by power/capacity prices, post-bankruptcy history, GAAP EPS -4.79 in 2025 and net debt/EBITDA 19.9x after acquisitions (acq/FCF 4.7x).

name: Envista Holdings Corp.
reason: Dental equipment/consumables business with adjusted EPS at 0.61x its 10y peak, 10y avg ROIC -0.4% after impairments and only 4% 5y EPS CAGR; an ordinary, share-losing business without a moat.

name: BellRing Brands, Inc.
reason: High-ROIC (30.5% 10y avg) Premier Protein brand but consensus FY1 EPS -51.9% signals a sharp margin reset from competition/private label and promotion in RTD protein, so normalized earnings and moat durability cannot be forecast with confidence.

name: The Baldwin Insurance Group, Inc.
reason: Insurance-brokerage roll-up with acquisitions at 22.9x cumulative FCF, net debt/EBITDA 5.96x and negative 10y avg ROIC (-3.6%); growth comes from leverage and M&A, not the core business.

name: Skydance Corp.
reason: Newly merged Paramount/Skydance media conglomerate mid-transformation with adjusted EPS at 0.08x its 10y peak, net debt/EBITDA 3.9x and secular linear-TV decline; outcome of the streaming/studio turnaround is not forecastable.

name: UiPath, Inc.
reason: RPA software that only turned GAAP-profitable in 2025 (EBIT margin 3.8%, 10y avg -56%) and faces direct disintermediation from AI agents/LLM-based automation within 5 years.

name: Weatherford International plc
reason: Oilfield services company whose earnings follow upstream capex/oil prices, with EPS 0.97x 10y peak, margin near its 10y high and a bankruptcy-driven 63%/yr share count history.

name: O-I Glass, Inc.
reason: Capital-intensive glass container maker with flat revenue (0.4% 10y CAGR), 10y avg ROIC 1.5%, net debt/EBITDA 3.66x and secular volume pressure; a cheap (4.8x P/E) but ordinary business.

name: Perdoceo Education Corp.
reason: For-profit online education with EBIT margin 23.2% near its 10y high and earnings dependent on Title IV federal aid rules, a credible regulatory threat; flat 10y revenue and single-analyst coverage.

name: The Carlyle Group Inc.
reason: Alternative asset manager whose earnings swing with capital-markets activity and realizations (EBIT margin -17.5% to 47.7% in 10y, worst EPS year -48.7%) with net debt/EBITDA 7.8x.

name: Reynolds Consumer Products, Inc.
reason: Mature foil/trash-bag brand with adjusted EPS down 3.6%/yr over 5y, EBIT margin 13.2% vs 18.8% high from resin/aluminum cost exposure and private-label share loss; consensus LTG 2% gives no route to 7% growth.

name: GQG Partners, Inc.
reason: Single-founder active manager whose fee earnings are set by market levels and flows, with consensus EPS declining (FY1 -8.5%, FY2 -16.6%) as performance-driven outflows hit; capital-markets dependent.

name: Upstart Holdings, Inc.
reason: AI consumer-lending marketplace whose earnings depend on credit spreads and funding-market appetite (EPS 2.37 in 2021 to -0.56 in 2023) with net debt/EBITDA 12.5x; credit-cycle driven.

name: UWM Holdings Corp.
reason: Wholesale mortgage originator whose earnings are set by interest rates and refinance volumes (EPS 1.61 in 2020 to 0.12 in 2025, 5y CAGR -40.5%) with net debt/EBITDA 7.3x.

name: Alkami Technology, Inc.
reason: Sticky digital-banking SaaS for credit unions and community banks but still GAAP loss-making every year (EBIT margin -10.9% in 2025), so steady-state margins and 5-10y EPS cannot yet be forecast.

name: Vertex, Inc.
reason: Mission-critical indirect-tax determination software embedded in ERP workflows with a secular e-invoicing/VAT-mandate driver, net cash-neutral balance sheet (net debt/EBITDA 0.11x) and consensus EPS growth of 28%/24%/21%; GAAP margins near zero (adj/GAAP gap large) must be checked in deep dive.
